verdict.rationale: The monitoring guide documents watching a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and receiving signed change events. That covers tracking target pages for content or listing changes and being notified. Detection is schedule-based, so notifications arrive at the next scheduled check rather than strictly as changes happen. Missing for 10: detail on schedule granularity or detection latency, explicit field-level change detection (e.g. price diffs), delivery mechanics (webhook config, retries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
